primary_gate.qualification: Only separately preregistered formal three-seed training, never reuse source-fold weights

limitations: One model seed and one genuinely held sourceRX1, six classes/1260 distinct visibleL; multiple checkpoints are not independent seeds.
Default-head performance changes include jointly learned W and feature changes; no fitted/replaced head, no claim of unseenTX or satellite deployment.

MeanCE/margins are preserved aggregates from the declared native default-head inference; per-packet labels/predictions independently verify all errors, confusion matrices, F1, paired corrections and day metrics.
Tail averaging is a fixed same-trajectory export, not a new globally novel algorithm or proof of useful features by itself.
